calibrate-task-estimates.note: The inherited article contained unsupported authority language, arbitrary milestone ranges, fixed buffer percentages, invented timing rules and claimed calibration improvements. The effective public record is narrowed to a local planned-versus-actual feedback loop for comparable work without presenting a universal estimation formula.

challenge-assumed-intent.note: The inherited article contained fabricated conflict outcomes, unsupported neurological mechanism claims, arbitrary evidence-count thresholds, fixed response delays and overbroad security, legal and interpersonal prescriptions. The effective public record separates observable facts from inferred intent and uses alternative explanations, relevant checks and neutral clarification for ordinary ambiguous situations.

check-base-rates-before-deciding.note: The inherited article contained unsupported accuracy claims, fabricated outcomes, arbitrary confidence thresholds and high-stakes medical, political, hiring and relationship prescriptions. The effective public record is narrowed to an ordinary data-literacy procedure for choosing a relevant reference class, checking comparability and combining a baseline with case-specific information while preserving uncertainty.

choose-best-resources.note: The inherited article contained fabricated internal project outcomes, universal freshness windows, arbitrary time and price thresholds and unsupported follow-through claims. The effective public record is narrowed to selecting and testing resources against a concrete next output, with explicit checks for authority, freshness, licensing, security and actual fit.

calibrate-task-estimates.reason: The effective protocol records an estimate against a concrete deliverable, compares it with the eventual completion conditions and uses the difference to adjust future planning. Planning & Prioritization is primary; Work Systems captures the recurring calibration record.

challenge-assumed-intent.reason: The effective protocol identifies when intent has been inferred rather than observed, separates facts from interpretation, considers alternative explanations and checks missing information. Cognitive Biases captures the assumption check; Critical Thinking captures the verification procedure.

check-base-rates-before-deciding.reason: The effective protocol selects a relevant reference class, inspects the scope of a baseline and combines general frequency information with case-specific facts. Data Literacy is primary; Critical Thinking captures the applicability and uncertainty checks.

choose-best-resources.reason: The effective protocol filters information, tools and other inputs against a concrete next output and records a keep, test or archive decision. Information Management is primary; Work Systems covers the repeatable intake and evaluation workflow.
